# mira-app

Reports for small shops, shown on a kiosk and emailed.
# 1. Mira approves every new product name

Date: 2026-08-03

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-08-03; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「No product gets a name until I have said yes.」 — Mira Example, 2026-08-03

**Options considered:**
- a new product name is used only after mira approves it in writing (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** product-naming

A new product name is used only after Mira approves it in writing.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 2. Reports go out weekly

Date: 2026-08-10

## Status

Superseded by 0014

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-08-10; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Weekly is enough; the shops do not read more often.」 — Mira Example, 2026-08-10

**Options considered:**
- the report job runs once a week, on monday morning (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** report-cadence

The report job runs once a week, on Monday morning.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
